title: Add Governed Colab Results Directory and Zip Archive Registry
trigger: User requested a results directory to house Colab output and governance requiring each zip be inducted and registered.

included: SSOT and local agent rule updates

governance_rule: Every Colab result zip must be inducted through registry/induction_registry.json, bound to governance/live/induction_queue.json, and registered in registry/colab_result_archive_registry.json before citation or interpretation.

claim_humility_review.bounded_statement: This patch establishes output routing and registration requirements only. It does not classify any new zip as C2 or validate any notebook result.
